meaning: Per-claim formalization status for the Lean 4 layer. A status here records what the Lean kernel checked and nothing else: it cannot promote, close, or reclassify a Layer 0 (source-bound review) status in STATUS.md or PROOF_INDEX.md, and a kernel-checked arithmetic lemma does not make its surrounding analytic argument verified.

status_levels.none: No Lean object. The claim lives only in Layer 0 prose.
status_levels.specified: A Lean statement (a `def ... : Prop`) compiles; no proof is offered. Its hypotheses are the exact claimed scope.
status_levels.proved: A Lean proof compiles but depends on project-declared axioms (for example an unformalized parent theorem taken as an explicit axiom with a scope note) or on axioms outside the allow-list other than the forbidden ones.
status_levels.kernel-checked: A Lean proof compiles and `#print axioms` reports only allowed axioms. No sorry, no native_decide, no project axioms.

alignment_review_levels.open: Author-side only. Nobody other than the author has checked that the Lean statement says what the informal anchor says.
alignment_review_levels.reviewed: A distinct reviewer has recorded, in formal/reviews/, that the Lean statement matches the informal anchor at the stated scope. Same-provider reviewers earn zero organizational-independence credit.

cross_check_schema.note: An AI-prover success is an additional lane, recorded here; it is still checked by the same kernel and does not replace the alignment review.
